title: Wendell and the Ember
premise: Ivo Delacroix, a debt-bound scribe in the magic-outlawed city of Vell, discovers tonight's date inscribed in a century-old book of prophecies — and watches a stranger named Wendell step out of its pages carrying the Ember, a living shard of forbidden power. Hunted by the Ashen Wardens and betrayed by the temple master who owns her debt, Ivo must decide whether to destroy the Ember, which holds her erased childhood memories, or use it to break magic's ban and reignite the old war. When the thirteenth moon rises, Ivo chooses neither: she swallows the Ember herself, becoming the living archive of a history both sides wanted buried. In the end she burns her debt contract with her own new fire, frees Wendell from the prophecy that made him, and walks out of Vell carrying a secret no one can confiscate.
about_author: Hazel Crane is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing confiscated grimoires before turning to fiction. She writes fantasy about people who carry dangerous knowledge, from a cluttered study overlooking a harbor she refuses to name.

chapters.title: Ink Sold by the Dram
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. In the outlaw city of Vell, debt-bound scribe Ivo sells watered-down charms from a temple stall, counting days toward freedom. She copies prophecies she isn't allowed to read, including one line she can't resist: tonight's date, written a century ago. Emotional beat: weary longing, the ache of a life on hold.

chapters.title: The Man Stepped Out of the Margin
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. At the stroke of the hour named in the prophecy, Wendell appears in the temple archive — confused, soot-marked, clutching a coal that glows like a heartbeat. Wardens converge; Ivo lies to save them both. Emotional beat: terror braided with the first thrill she has felt in years.

chapters.title: What the Wardens Burn
chapters.summary: Wendell's POV. Fleeing through Vell's ash-choked lower quarters, Wendell explains he was a prophecy-keeper sent forward with the Ember to keep it from the Ashen Wardens. Ivo sees her own childhood street in his memories — a street that no longer exists. Emotional beat: vertigo of a past that doesn't add up.

chapters.title: The Debt Ledger
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Master Corvane, who owns Ivo's debt, reveals he knows about Wendell and offers to erase her contract if she delivers the Ember. She pretends to agree, hating how easily temptation fits her hand. Emotional beat: shame, and the first crack in her obedience.

chapters.title: Thirteen Turns
chapters.summary: Wendell's POV. Hidden in a smuggler's cellar, Wendell teaches Ivo the prophecy: at the thirteenth moon, the Ember must be destroyed or crowned, and war follows either path. Ivo realizes the Ember hums only when she touches it. Emotional beat: dread curdling into a terrible suspicion of belonging.

chapters.title: The Memory in the Coal
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Touching the Ember deliberately, Ivo sees her erased childhood: her mother was an Ember-keeper, her memories confiscated by the Wardens, her debt a cage designed to keep her blind. Emotional beat: grief and fury — her whole life was someone else's edit.

chapters.title: A Bargain in Ash
chapters.summary: Wendell's POV. Corvane's Wardens storm the cellar; Wendell is captured, and the Ember passes to Ivo alone. Corvane offers her a final choice: her freedom for the Ember, delivered before the thirteenth moon. Emotional beat: betrayal sharpened into resolve — she now knows exactly who edited her life.

chapters.title: The Archive Beneath
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Using her scribe's access, Ivo descends into Vell's sealed deep archive, where the original prophecies — and the record of the old war — are kept. She learns the Ember is not a weapon but a witness: the compiled memory of everyone the war erased. Emotional beat: awe, and the weight of a secret too large for one person.

chapters.title: The Thirteenth Moon
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. On the archive roof under the full thirteenth moon, Corvane demands the Ember, Wendell escapes his cell to stand beside her, and Wardens ring the tower. Refusing both destruction and coronation, Ivo swallows the Ember and takes every erased memory into herself as fire. Emotional beat: the climax — self-annihilation chosen as self-definition.

chapters.title: What Ivo Keeps
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV, coda. The Ember's light settles in Ivo's veins; Corvane's claim crumbles when she burns her debt contract with a touch, and the Wardens, seeing their own erased kin in her eyes, lower their blades. Wendell, freed from the prophecy's script, chooses to stay. Emotional beat: quiet, hard-won peace — a woman who is now the history no one can outlaw.
